steps.title: Collect your items from your death …
steps.text: Collect your items from your death bank and store your things in your looting bag. — Keep a Marrentil out of your bag. — Gear up for questing. — You can get Looting bags from points at Last man standing. Or kill Thugs in the Edgeville Dungeon for a slight risk. — You can bag items while at the Ferox Enclave. You don't need to risk going into the Wilderness.

steps.title: Get a kitten from Gertrude and …
steps.text: Get a kitten from Gertrude and start growing it. Put it in your house when it has grown. — You can fish karambwanji for stackable fish. Bring a small fishing net. — (Optional) After it grows you can also complete Icthlarin's Little Helper and Ratcatchers to get a wily cat.

steps.title: Complete Bone Voyage. — Make sure …
steps.text: Complete Bone Voyage. — Make sure to get your lamps from Historian Minas for some Herblore xp. — You can now start farming your seeds with Ultracompost if you would like. — You can buy Pineapples from the Trader Crewmember in Catherby and note them at the Farming patch to the north. — If you have any leaves left in your Forestry kit, you can use those as a stackable item to fill the compost bin. Then make some Compost potions to turn it into supercompost and then the ultracompost. — Make sure you clean the herbs before you note them. It saves a lot of time.

steps.title: Obtain 70 Cooking. — An easy …
steps.text: Obtain 70 Cooking. — An easy method is to buy and cook fish from Frankie's Fishing Emporium, however there are other options. Ultimate Ironman Guide/Cooking. — You can use an alt to light fires to cook the fish without going to the range. — If you have an alt you could also go for Tai Bwo Wannai Trio at cook Karambwans from the shop and have the alt make a fire. — You can get an Agility potion from Dr Jekyll if you carry a clean irit around with you. This could take awhile so you can do other stuff in the meantime and just come back to this later when you get it.

steps.title: Complete Monkey Madness I. — Get …
steps.text: Complete Monkey Madness I. — Get all the greegrees needed for Recipe for Disaster/Freeing King Awowogei during this this quest. — Give Zooknock the materials for a second Ninja monkey greegree but don't take the greegree yet, come back and claim it when needed for Monkey Madness II. — Do the training with Daero focused on Strength after the quest. — Be careful not to die to the Jungle Demon as getting your stuff back is very annoying.

steps.title: Complete The Fremennik Trials. — Remember …
steps.text: Complete The Fremennik Trials. — Remember that you can use protection from melee for the fight, so if you can prayer flick well you don't need to prepare very much. You don't need to beat the 4th form, just let it down you and it will still count. — You will need to death pile for this.

steps.title: Complete The Fremennik Isles. — Put …
steps.text: Complete The Fremennik Isles. — Put the xp on Strength. — Use fire blast on the 10 troll kills, melee the boss. — Either gear up now with your melee setup for the boss, or use this cheese strategy : https://youtu.be/tfDBAyn_ExY?si=3qsaTR8Nz9AtbqrE

steps.title: Gear up for combat training using …
steps.text: Gear up for combat training using the setup at the bottom of this section. — If you are planning to boost your Fighter Torso, you could do it now. Otherwise wait for better combat stats. — Switch to the Helm of neitiznot once you get 55 Defense. It can be alched and bought back later.
steps.note: Nightmare Zone north of Yanille; Venator bow on Long-range earns Defence, or absorption Rumble for AFK.

steps.title: Train at ammonite crabs until you …
steps.text: Train at ammonite crabs until you reach 65 Attack and Strength. — Go for 56 Strength, then 60 Attack, then 65 Strength, then 65 Attack. — During this grind do birdhouse runs until at least 57 Hunter, but you can go higher. Store needed logs in your log basket. — 57 unlocks medium Hunter Rumours for getting level 70 later. — You can also train with normal Hunter methods if you would like. — Buy seeds from one of the seed shops such as Amelia's Seed Shop to use. — (Optional) Train some Defense levels as well. They will come in handy. — Farm tree seeds during this grind, especially fruit trees. You are hoping to get a Hespori seed for death banking. — If you happen to get a spirit seed, save it and use it to make a Spirit tree (Construction). You will want to make an effort to get your Farming up to use it sooner than you would otherwise. — The reason the guide recommends ammonite crabs is for the fossils. These can be stored in Fossil storage and used for lamps later. This will actually add up to a large amount of experience, but the guide doesn't rely on it. — You are welcome to other methods such as the Gemstone crab, Sand crabs, or Nightmare Zone.
steps.note: Nightmare Zone Normal Rumble north of Yanille - very AFK with absorption + overload potions (needs ~5 quests).
